title: Umme Abeeha Zahera
body:
Ya zahera ya zahera .
Umme abeeha zahera
Qalbe mustafa zahera
Roohe laa ilaa zahera
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Ummat ne haai tujhko kitna rulaaya bibi
Baba ke baad tere kitna sataaya bibi
Dar tera wo jalaakar khushiya manaaya bibi
Paani na tere laal ko qatra pilaaya bibi
Haai ye kaisa hai sitam
Har taraf hai gham hi gham
Jeena sakenge ab ham
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Tazeem teri karte rehte the mustafa bhi
Jannat ko leke jaate the rizwaan teri roti
Kaisa sitam ye toota itne me tujhpe bibi
Jin haatho me shifa thi aaya tha usme chakki
Zulm balaao me ghiri
Shere arab ki beti
Kaise chalaaye chakki
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Ghar ko lagi thi aag tadapti hi tu rahi
Darwaaza girgaya tha tarasti hi tu rahi
Pehlu bhi shikasta tha sehti hi tu rahi
Mohsin ki shahaadat se roti hi tu rahi
Baaghe fidak loota hai
Ranjo alam toota hai
Baba tera choota hai
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Kehne lagi fizza se roroke ye tatheer
Khaana mere bacho ko khilaadena ay hamsheer
Paani pilaana shai ko bhoolona ay dilgeer
Kehke ye saans todi wo sabr ki tasweer
Kehne lage ye haider
Cheek maarke rokar
Binte payambar ka sabar
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Fizza ne kahaa bacho se ab aao khaana khaao
Shabbir badhke pooche maadar kaha bataao
Ay amma fizza hamko itna to na rulaao
"Althaf aur zaighum” likho zahera ki dua paavo
Roye shabbir-o-shabbar
Aur fatahe-qaibar
Royi Zainab-e-muztar
